items.title: Understanding Data
items.explanation: Data is any collection of facts, numbers, measures, observations, or descriptions that conveys information about something. For example, asking classmates about their favorite colors creates a list of colors, which is data. Similarly, measuring the weight of each student produces a collection of weight measures, also known as data.

items.title: Collecting and Organizing Data
items.explanation: To find the most popular item in a group, one must first collect data by asking individuals about their preferences. This data is then organized using tally marks to count how many times each option appears. For instance, Shri Nilesh asked children about sweets; he used tally marks ('|') to record counts and lines ('||') when the count reached 5 to mark it as complete.
